stem: A car travels from town A to town B at 30 km/h and returns along the same road at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole trip?
explanation: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time, not the average of the two speeds. For equal distances it is 2 × 30 × 90 ÷ (30 + 90) = 45 km/h.

stem: Two buses leave towns 575 km apart at the same time and drive toward each other, one at 70 km/h and the other at 45 km/h. After how many hours do they meet?
explanation: They close the gap at 70 + 45 = 115 km/h. Time = 575 ÷ 115 = 5 hours.
